examples.description: Twelve monthly GST tax invoices from 1 Oct 2026 (12:00 UTC of that date), the last one on 1 Sep 2027

preconditions: Materialization is CRON-ONLY (daily, jobs kernel): templates become draft invoices on next_due's business day — no read path ever materializes.

items_json: JSON array of {description, quantity, unit_price_cents, position}, plus optional unit, discount_bps and tax_code per line; quantity takes up to 3 decimals — validated by the cron before any state change.

next_due is epoch millis: the daily run at 16:30 UTC (00:30 in Singapore and Kuala Lumpur) makes the draft invoice on the calendar day next_due falls on in the business time zone (sales_settings.timezone, unset = Asia/Singapore), dated that day; a day the run missed is made at the next run, still dated that day. For a date, send 12:00 UTC of that date (30 Sep 2026 = 1790769600000): it falls on that date in every listed zone, while 00:00 UTC falls on the day before west of UTC.

tax_scheme sg_gst or my_sst makes each invoice under that scheme at the rate in force on its issue day, each line taxed by its items_json tax_code (sg_gst default standard; every my_sst line needs one); "none" prices by tax_rate_bps; unset takes your sales settings' tax_scheme on each run. ends_on (epoch millis, the last day an invoice may be dated) and max_invoices (invoices in all) end the template: after its last invoice the run makes no more. A run that cannot make the invoice makes nothing, keeps the template due and says why in invoice_reminders_due (recurring_held). Nothing is ever sent: each invoice is a draft listed there under issues.
